title: Toned Legs & Abs
description: Single-leg work (pulse squats, Bulgarian split squats) then full core with V-ups

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Pulse squats
exercises.instructions: Stay at the bottom of the squat, small up-and-down pulses

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squats
exercises.instructions: Back foot on a chair, lower the knee

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions: On one leg, hinge your torso forward, back leg extended

exercises.name: Isometric squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold the bottom squat position without moving

exercises.name: Plank hold
exercises.instructions: On your forearms, body perfectly aligned, brace your core

exercises.name: V-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift arms and legs together to touch your feet

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs in the air, extend opposite arm/leg alternating

exercises.name: Toe touches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs vertical, touch your feet with your hands

exercises.name: Hip flexor stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
